subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: From my school days I heard a lot about college life. (a) ⎯⎯ I was eagerly waiting for the day. (b) ⎯⎯ the cherished day came. It was the 26th October 1992. (c) ⎯⎯ I reached the college, I found the whole college campus crowded by lots of young pupils. (d) ⎯⎯ all of them were unknown to me. I felt very lonely. (e) ⎯⎯ I met one of my school friends. I was relieved.
guide_solution: (a) So, (b) Finally (c) As (d) But (e) All on a sudden
